 Liam Delap 
 647 98 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Yates couldn't shoot quick enough' published at 18:59 GMT 18:59 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 Ryan Yates just couldn't get his shot off quick enough and Elliott Anderson managed to get it over the bar. I still think City are on top.
 114 264 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 18:59 GMT 18:59 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Iliman Ndiaye is steaming through the middle of the park and Dan Ndoye has to take one for the team, dragging the winger back to prevent him getting any further.
 Into the book he goes.
 163 88 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:58 GMT 18:58 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Nottingham Forest not out of this yet as Ryan Yates' shot takes a deflection off Elliot Anderson and it could drop anywhere.
 Gianluigi Donnarumma is backtracking and looks concerned but it lands on top of his net.
 143 62 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:55 GMT 18:55 GMT 
 Use 'Get involved' to have your say 
 Forest just need to keep it steady get back that aggressive style from the first half can't help a worldie.
 Chris, Nottingham 
 484 107 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'City will get something back' published at 18:55 GMT 18:55 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 Again it's just one ball in behind. The City defenders are so tight, Liam Delap is weaving and bobbing and using his strength. 
 The signs are there that Forest can still get something out of this but I do think it'll be City that get something back from this game. 
 140 311 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 18:55 GMT 18:55 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Oliver Glasner turns to his bench to try to stop these waves of City attacks.
 James McAtee and Daniel Munoz make way for Luca Netz and Dan Ndoye.
 129 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 18:55 GMT 18:55 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Hello.
 Liam Delap and Abdukodir Khusanov get in a bit of a wrestling match and the referee doesn't get involved there but Elliot Anderson picks up the loose ball and James McAtee flies in, this time the referee goes to his pocket.
 67 71 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:51 GMT 18:51 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 Forest are clinging on, Daniel Munoz wants to go tight every time with Jeremy Doku and Doku isn't having it. 
 194 100 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:51 GMT 18:51 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 City win a corner and Matz Sels is absolutely fuming as it's put right on his toes and he has to slap it away almost from the underside of his crossbar.
 You feel that defeat here would seriously damage City's hopes of challenging for the Premier League title but a point or even a win would majorly galvanise Enzo Maresca's side.
 107 97 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:50 GMT 18:50 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 A proper tussle between Morgan Gibbs-White and his former team-mate Elliot Anderson after a good ball released the Forest man and eventually the referee says Gibbs-White was in the wrong and awards City a free-kick.
 162 247 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:48 GMT 18:48 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Rayan Cherki has scored five goals in his last eight Premier League games, more than he netted in his first 34 (four).
 184 195 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:47 GMT 18:47 GMT 
 Use 'Get involved' to have your say 
 This years 'Goal of the season' competition ends here. What a hit on the half volley from Cherki... sweet as!
 Nick, London 
 309 866 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 18:47 GMT 18:47 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 You just expect the net to bulge here as Erling Haaland takes a touch to set himself then tries to curl into the top corner but it's not got enough bend on it and it flies high and wide.
 204 140 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:46 GMT 18:46 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Whatever Enzo Maresca said at the break, it seems to have had the desired effect.
 That goal has reinvigorated this side and they seem to be the ones in the ascendency now.
 212 335 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Absolute rocket' published at 18:45 GMT 18:45 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Steve Stone 
Former England midfielder on BBC Radio 5 live 
 An absolute rocket on the half volley from Rayan Cherki.
 It gets played over the top, Jeremy Doku gets round the back and it takes a deflection. 
 It falls to Cherki and it's a rocket, goalkeeper Matz Sels stands no chance. 
 252 296 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:45 GMT 18:45 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Matz Sels paws the corner away and it hits the back of his own player before coming back to him to catch.
 He tries to get his side quickly up the pitch but the attack breaks down.
 63 34 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:44 GMT 18:44 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Game on? Manchester City chop the deficit to one goal and Jeremy Doku twice goes close to levelling things up.
 His latest cross takes a deflection and almost ends up in the back of the net but it's behind for a corner.
 156 196 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Whooooosh published at 18:43 GMT 18:43 GMT 
 Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City 
 Shamoon Hafez 
Football reporter at the City Ground 
 What a finish that is from Rayan Cherki. City need a goal early in the second half and they have got it.
 Game on.
 347 462 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Nottm Forest 2-1 Man City published at 18:42 GMT 18:42 GMT 
 Rayan Cherki (52 mins) 
 What a hit!
 Nottingham Forest think they have cleared the danger as the ball is clipped away but it drops to Rayan Cherki and that is some hit from the Frenchman.
 He absolutely leathers it into the roof of the net. No saving that.
